text: This is what happens when a jet engine swallows a goose.
The fan at the front spins thousands of times a minute, pulling in a huge amount of air.
A Canada goose can weigh several kilograms. Heavier than the birds engines like these had to keep running after.
It smashes the blades, the airflow breaks down, and the engine can't keep itself running.
In two thousand nine, that happened to both engines of an Airbus at once, right over New York.
So the captain landed on a river. Full video on my channel.
